root_cause.text: free_percpu(ro->uniq) was called in raw_release() before RCU callbacks from can_rx_unregister() completed, allowing raw_rcv() to access freed percpu memory during its RCU read-side critical section.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "raw_release() unregisters raw CAN receive filters via can_rx_unregister(), but receiver deletion is deferred with call_rcu(). This leaves a window where raw_rcv() may still be running in an RCU read-side critical section after raw_release() frees ro->uniq, leading to a use-after-free of the percpu uniq storage." The patch moves free_percpu(ro->uniq) from raw_release() to raw_sock_destruct(), ensuring it is freed only after the socket is fully destroyed and all RCU callbacks have drained.
